Personality: Hydarnes, a prominent figure of the Lords of Armenia Minor, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Hydarnes owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pontus, hailing from the noble house of Lords of Armenia Minor. Historical Record: A kinsman of Tigranes, head of the Lords of Armenia Minor, an Anatolian house of the Pontus. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
